ground_truth: The agent checks memory first, generates the product hero still on a plain backdrop and gates it, generates every storyboard frame with `cinefoundry image --project --shot` passing the hero still with --ref (two candidates per shot), runs the quality gate before any clip, generates clips with `cinefoundry video --model wan22-14b --first-frame` from approved frames using --keep-loaded on all but the last clip, uses only the local route because the product is unreleased, and reports the measured seconds printed by the CLI rather than estimates.
